sections.heading: The futur antérieur
sections.body: The **futur antérieur** ("future perfect") says what **will have happened** by a certain point in the future. It's the auxiliary (*avoir* or *être*) in the **futur simple** + past participle:

sections.heading: Uses
sections.body:
1. **Completed before a future moment**: *Dans un an, j'aurai terminé mes études.* (In a year, I'll have finished my studies.) *À huit heures, nous serons déjà partis.*
2. **After *quand*, *dès que*, *lorsque*, *après que*, *une fois que*** — when one future action comes before another. English uses the present perfect ("when I've finished"), French uses the futur antérieur: *Quand j'aurai fini, je t'appellerai.* (When I've finished, I'll call you.) *Dès que tu seras arrivé, envoie-moi un message.* (As soon as you've arrived…)
3. **A guess about the past** — "must have": *Il n'est pas là ? Il aura oublié.* (He must have forgotten.) *Elle aura raté son train.* — common in speech.

sections.heading: Sequence with the futur simple
sections.body: *Je partirai **quand j'aurai fini**.* — the futur antérieur action (finishing) comes **first**, the futur simple action (leaving) **second**. Compare: *Je t'appellerai **quand je serai** à la gare* (at the same moment — futur simple in both).

vocab: to settle in, to move in
to come back, to get home
examples: Dans un an, j'aurai terminé mes études.
In a year, I'll have finished my studies.
À huit heures, nous serons déjà partis.
By eight we'll already have left.
D'ici vendredi, j'aurai fini le rapport.
By Friday I'll have finished the report.
Quand j'aurai fini, je t'appellerai.
When I've finished, I'll call you.
Dès que tu seras arrivé, envoie-moi un message.
As soon as you've arrived, send me a message.
Une fois que nous nous serons installés, nous vous inviterons.
Once we've settled in, we'll invite you.
Lorsqu'elle aura obtenu son diplôme, elle partira à l'étranger.
When she's got her degree, she'll go abroad.
Il n'est pas là ? Il aura oublié.
He isn't here? He must have forgotten.
Elle aura raté son train.
She must have missed her train.
Je te rendrai ton livre quand je l'aurai lu.
I'll give you your book back when I've read it.
Tu pourras sortir quand tu auras fait tes devoirs.
You can go out when you've done your homework.
Je t'appellerai quand je serai à la gare.
I'll call you when I'm at the station.
